unresolved.detail: The 78 rows are bounded source proposals, not a complete public capability inventory; RM02-RM07 remain blocked until every public surface is represented.
The candidate Git object is available at the requested SHA, but the primary checkout retains an unrelated protected vendor deletion and is not an exact-SHA execution environment.
Codebase Memory transport was unavailable or not exact-SHA pinned for this audit, so exact source truth came from read-only Git object commands.
No candidate-SHA behavioral oracle, CI, rollback, cutover, or retirement command was run; all 78 observed results remain unmeasured.
C3-005 is a source-visible product gap: OnConflict::Intent is parsed and advertised, but native claim execution does not persist an edit intent or notify it after release.
C3-014 and C3-015 have native MCP surfaces, but source review found narrower or miswired health, presence, workers, tasks, and guard behavior; executable differential proof is still required.

proves: The candidate, public, provenance, and both overlay commit objects resolve.
RM00, README, PLAN_STATE, WORKPACK_INDEX, and canonical RM01 were read from the candidate SHA in the required order.
Four disjoint bounded source inventories produced exactly 78 unique row proposals.
Public, provenance-only, and private-overlay authority roles were kept separate.
The handoff contains source/test anchors and proof requirements only; no behavioral parity verdict is claimed.
doesNotProve: exit-code, diagnostic, framing, or schema-runtime parity
candidate executable success or CI/release readiness
rollback rehearsal, production cutover, or legacy deletion closure
